policy.scope: Non-core training controls only: data.batch_size and train.optimizer.learning_rate.
policy.reuse: After a stage is calibrated, all later experiments at the same stage reuse the locked values for comparable conditions.
policy.batch_size: Probe powers of two deterministically, then keep one power-of-two margin below the largest passing value when possible.
policy.learning_rate: Probe a fixed optimizer-specific ladder deterministically, then keep one ladder step below the largest stable value when possible.
policy.comparison: Final comparisons must use locked controls, not per-experiment retuning.
